scope: Estimated time to hospital road proxies, not measured ETA; lateral snap gap excluded

origin_mapping.method: nearest road segment with directional partial-edge start
origin_mapping.scope: Only origin access may use missing-width/local service roads. Upon reaching a strict node with directed connectivity to a hospital goal, supplemental edges cannot be used again; isolated strict islands remain origin access. Turn restrictions are enforced by the search.
origin_mapping.limits: Nearest road is not proof of physical access across sidewalks/walls; unknown or private gates remain excluded.
